_help: Act 2, the caravanserai: hiring Saleh al-Rashidi, the veteran guide (hired_saleh), 70. He tests how you mean to cross the desert. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: saleh
already.line: Six days more water than you think. Always.

first.speaker: saleh
first.line: Abdel says you want a guide. Where to?

choices.label: Akmentar
choices.line: West, past the last well. Akmentar.

where.speaker: saleh
where.line: I know that road. I also know three men who did not come back from it. Tell me how you mean to cross.

choices.label: As fast as we can
choices.line: As fast as we can. There are others racing us.

fast.speaker: saleh
fast.line: Then you want a younger man. Fast is how the desert kills.

choices.label: Promise to listen
choices.line: Fast, but I'll listen when you say stop.

choices.label: Find another guide
choices.line: Then I'll find someone who can keep up.

refer.speaker: saleh
refer.line: Try the boy Youssef, by the well. He is quick, and cheap, and he has never buried anyone. Yet.

fee.speaker: saleh
fee.line: Seventy pounds. I am expensive because my travellers come home.

choices.label: Haggle
choices.line: Seventy is a lot of money.

haggle.speaker: saleh
haggle.line: My price is my price. If you want cheaper, ask Youssef. If you want a merchant, ask Farid. If you want to live, ask me.

joined.speaker: saleh
joined.line: Then we leave with water for six days more than you think you need.
